# Repository About

## Chinese Description

本地优先的语音转写后端服务：本地 ASR 模型、长音频分块与断点续跑、说话人分离、段落化导出。

## English Description

Local-first speech transcription backend service with local ASR models, long-audio chunking and resume, speaker diarization, and paragraph exports.
